svg.title: Mockup 17 (plan): Food settings
svg.text: 17 · Food settings, per event: settling up and the AI reader (organiser)
Redrawn for the plan: paying the holder directly is an event setting (U12 note, M1); the AI reader is off until turned on (M3, D10).
A · Ordering

g.text: Off: the Food page shows your note

svg.text: B · Times and forgotten orders
C · Settling up and the AI reader

g.text: After the event, in the payment system
The holder then picks per order:
via the organiser, or paid to them
Photos go to an outside service
a receipt, $0.002 a menu page. People
see this before a photo is sent.

svg.text: Settling up (M1, U12 note)
People pay the organiser after the event, through the
payment system: always available, and the default. One
switch lets holders take payment directly; the holder
then chooses per order (mockup 19).
The AI reader is off until turned on
It also needs a provider key that the platform
operator sets; without one, the switch is greyed with
"Not set up on this platform". It reads receipts
(mockup 18) and menus (mockup 11).
What it costs
Claude Haiku 5.5: $0.10 per million input tokens and
$0.50 per million output, from Anthropic's pricing
page (read 2026-11-19). A photo costs at most about
4,800 input tokens, so a receipt is about $0.001 and a
menu page about $0.002. The daily cap bounds a whole
event.
Sliders and steppers, legacy defaults
Last call 10 min, reminders at +30 and +60, release
after 2 h, done 2 h after arrival (#118).
Forgotten orders (U3, E4 notes)
The holder is reminded, then the crew. At the day's
turn an order never called in is cancelled, and one
never marked arrived is done, flagged in the record.
Saved through admin's settings
admin.settings.write (D5).
